description: Source code implementing Android media session client interface, handling media session state changes, callbacks, and JNI interactions for media control.

methods.name: MediaSessionActionsToPlaybackStateActions
methods.description: Converts a bitset of available actions into Android playback state actions bitset.

methods.name: CobaltExtensionPlaybackStateToPlaybackState
methods.description: Maps internal media session playback state to Android playback state.

methods.name: PlaybackStateActionToMediaSessionAction
methods.description: Converts Android playback state action to internal media session action.

methods.name: NativeInvokeAction
methods.description: Handles invocation of media session actions from Java via JNI.

methods.name: UpdateActiveSessionPlatformPlaybackState
methods.description: Updates the platform playback state callback.

methods.name: OnMediaSessionStateChanged
methods.description: Handles media session state change events, updates Java media session.

methods.name: RegisterMediaSessionCallbacks
methods.description: Registers JNI callbacks for media session events.

methods.name: DestroyMediaSessionClientCallback
methods.description: Unregisters JNI callbacks and deactivates media session.
